description: This file defines the 'Loan' class, representing a loan entity within a financial or lending application. It encompasses properties, relationships, and behaviors pertinent to loans, such as disbursements, repayments, charges, collateral, and status management. The class provides methods for creating new loan instances, updating loan details, managing transactions, and retrieving schedule and status information, supporting complex loan lifecycle handling.

classes.name: Loan
classes.description: Represents a loan with associated properties, lifecycle methods, and behavior for managing disbursements, repayments, charges, status, and related entities within a financial system.

methods.name: newIndividualLoanApplication
methods.description: Creates a new individual loan application instance with specified parameters such as account number, client, loan type, product, fund, officer, purpose, schedule, charges, collateral, and other relevant details.

methods.name: newGroupLoanApplication
methods.description: Creates a new group loan application with specified parameters, including group details and other associated loan information.

methods.name: newIndividualLoanApplicationFromGroup
methods.description: Creates an individual loan application derived from an existing group loan, incorporating client and group details along with other loan parameters.

methods.name: getNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of repayment installments as defined in the loan schedule.

methods.name: updateSummaryWithTotalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Updates the loan summary with total fee charges due at the time of disbursement.

methods.name: updateLoanSummaryForUndoWaiveCharge
methods.description: Adjusts the loan summary after waiving a charge, updating waived amounts and outstanding balances.

methods.name: deriveSumTotalOfChargesDueAtDisbursement

methods.name: associateChargesWithThisLoan

methods.name: associateWithThisLoan

methods.name: getLastRepaymentPeriodDueDate

methods.name: removeDisbursementDetails

methods.name: addLoanDisbursementDetails

methods.name: removeLoanTransaction

methods.name: getTotalInterest
methods.description: Computes the total interest charged on the loan according to the schedule.

methods.name: getTotalWrittenOff
methods.description: Returns the total amount written off on this loan.

methods.name: loanProduct
